changes: tools/qa_automation.py: load_all_scenes() and visual_bible.json reads were re-parsed from disk on every one of the ~20-30 independent checks run per qa_automation.py invocation (chapter files re-read up to 17x, visual_bible.json up to 5x). tools/semantic_concepts.py: concepts() previously rebuilt norm(phrase) and a fresh regex for all ~189 canonical phrases on every call; phrase normalization + regex compilation is now precomputed once at module import, and concepts()/norm() are memoized.

manifest_correction_2026_08_29c.fix: Recomputed SHA-256 for all 8 schemas/*.schema.json files directly from the package contents and replaced the compatibility.schema_sha256 values with those actual digests.
manifest_correction_2026_08_29c.note: This is a documentation/audit-trail correction only. No tool under tools/ reads RELEASE_MANIFEST_V9.json at runtime (grep-verified), so this discrepancy never affected pipeline behavior. manifest_correction_2026_08_29c.recommendation: Automate schema_sha256 (re)computation as a packaging step (e.g. in run_regression_suite.py or a release script) so this value can never again go stale relative to the shipped files.
